name: start-done
//: Issue #60, under its reporter's conditions: overleaf.com not cross-origin isolated, a returning project (its graph kept, the tab reloaded), errors and warnings, the PDF in its own tab (Overleaf's detached view), Chrome on an Apple-silicon Mac (its frozen user agent, its client hints). The start is done once pages are drawn, in either tab: the status says Built, not Starting; Copy debug info says built, the project's counts, the problems as the badge counts them, and the machine from the client hints; the errors icon opens the problems' list.
